name: When are construction details needed in drawings?

mainEntity.name: When are construction details needed in drawings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Details zoom in on complex joints, transitions, and assemblies—like window rough openings, stair framing, or cornice construction—to ensure proper installation and weatherproofing.
